topk.comparison: full sort vs production max heap, identical FP32 SIMD distance and query preparation
topk.statistic: paired workload arithmetic mean search latency, alternating order

memory.scope: graph buffer capacity plus graph object; embeddings and temporary insertion workspaces excluded; RSS delta separately reported

clustered.insertion_order: grouped by cluster, primary; same order for both algorithms
clustered.rule: Do not retune the fixture or parameters after observing recall; report failure if threshold is unmet.

dbpedia.timing_scope: QueryEngine search including preparation; prebuilt graph, no I/O or output
dbpedia.caveat: 1000 searches repeat 20 distinct held-out queries; no independence or production-SLA claim

cache.platform: Linux perf with permitted PMU access
cache.scope: 1000 DBpedia queries after warmup, graph build excluded using perf control FIFO
cache.baseline: frozen pre-optimization source or base commit with the same profiling driver
cache.caveat: Old-vs-new comparison combines kernel, selection, visited-set and layout changes; it does not isolate layout causality.
